name: update-card
description: Update an existing Trello card by ID.

cardId.description: The ID of the card to update

name.description: The new name of the card

desc.description: The new description of the card

idList.description: The ID of the list to move the card to

pos.description: Position of the card: top, bottom, or a positive float

dueComplete.description: Whether the due date is complete
